layouts.name: CSecondaryWindowRepresentation_Data
layouts.notes: CalculateWindowMetrics selects the represented CWindowData from +64. OnMarginsOrSizeUpdated independently uses the same pointer before recomputing cached source metrics; the constructor initializes it to null. Verified on 28000.3231.

layouts.name: CSecondaryWindowRepresentation_Kind
layouts.notes: CalculateWindowMetrics distinguishes live (1), snapshot/proxy (2), and iconic (3) representations using this DWORD. OnMarginsOrSizeUpdated and the native SWR notification independently select the same kinds; construction zeros +72. Verified on 28000.3231.

layouts.name: CSecondaryWindowRepresentation_Flags
layouts.notes: Initialize writes the four-byte SWRUsage argument at +40. CalculateWindowMetrics independently tests 0x4 for client-only, 0x80 for special source margins, and 0x100 for bypassing its desktop-source branch. Verified on 28000.3231.
